$comment: Who speaks with which voice, across all lessons. Written by the recording script; you only change "status". New characters arrive as "pending" with a sample to listen to (open the site with ?casting). Set "approved" to record their lines, or "rejected" to get the next-best voice and a new sample. "future" marks a character who is only mentioned so far: they get a voice the first time they speak in a lesson.

harriet.name: Harriet
harriet.description: A retired schoolteacher from Manchester in her sixties, on her first trip to Paris. Nervous but determined; speaks careful learner French with a British accent.

gilles.name: Gilles
gilles.description: A retired Parisian man in his seventies who feeds the pigeons at the Trocadéro every morning. Dry, deadpan, unhurried; a low, calm voice.

madame-benali.name: Madame Benali
madame-benali.description: The building’s gardienne, an older Parisian woman in her sixties. Warm, theatrical, expressive; knows everything about everyone and loves telling it.

clement.name: Clément
clement.description: A young man of 26 from Bordeaux, just moved to Paris. Polite, slightly overwhelmed; a natural, standard French accent.

monsieur-petrovic.name: Monsieur Petrovic
monsieur-petrovic.description: A retired opera chorus singer on the third floor, in his seventies. Grand, theatrical, a big rich voice; still sings at 2am.

madame-martin.name: Madame Martin
madame-martin.description: Half of the couple on the fourth floor who have been renovating for six years. Middle-aged, cheerful, always busy, a little vague about the works.

monsieur-martin.name: Monsieur Martin
monsieur-martin.description: The other half of the Martins on the fourth floor. Middle-aged, friendly, enthusiastic about DIY he never seems to finish.

ines.name: Inès
ines.description: A young woman on the fifth floor who gets a parcel every single day. Bright, friendly, a little secretive.

le-locataire-du-sixieme.name: Le locataire du sixième
le-locataire-du-sixieme.description: The sixth-floor tenant no one has ever seen, only his cat. Age and voice unknown: decide when he finally appears.

samir.name: Samir
samir.description: The narrator’s friend, a Parisian man of 34, middle-aged rather than young. Friendly and amused; a natural, relaxed Parisian accent.

monsieur-fabre.name: Monsieur Fabre
monsieur-fabre.description: A brocante seller in his sixties, an older Parisian man in a silk scarf. Theatrical and grandiose, a born showman who loves an audience.

madame-lucchini.name: Madame Lucchini
madame-lucchini.description: A brocante seller in her sixties, an older woman with glasses on her nose. Dry, blunt, deadpan and calm; warmth shows only at the end. Standard French, no accent.

mamie-yasmina.name: Mamie Yasmina
mamie-yasmina.description: Samir’s grandmother, ninety years old, with… particular taste in objects. Mentioned only so far.

margaux.name: Margaux
margaux.description: A Parisian woman of 35, middle-aged rather than young, shopping for a party. Friendly, quick, a little sheepish; a natural Parisian accent.

monsieur-vasseur.name: Monsieur Vasseur
monsieur-vasseur.description: A cheesemonger in his sixties, an older Parisian man who loves his cheeses like his children. Theatrical, grand and solemn, ridiculous but lovable.

madame-delorme.name: Madame Delorme
madame-delorme.description: The director of a small Paris museum, a Parisian woman in her fifties. Brisk, no-nonsense, dry and sceptical but fair; crisp, precise speech.

raymond.name: Raymond
raymond.description: The museum’s night guard, an older Parisian man of 64. Sincere, earnest, a little shaken; tells his story warmly, with wide eyes.

la-comtesse.name: La Comtesse
la-comtesse.description: The Countess in the museum portrait, who may or may not step out of her frame at night. Never speaks… yet.

antoine.name: Antoine
antoine.description: An accountant of 41, a middle-aged Parisian man who trusts only spreadsheets. Dry, precise and sceptical, then flustered.

madame-zara.name: Madame Zara
madame-zara.description: A fortune teller in Montmartre, an older Parisian woman. Theatrical and mysterious in her predictions, completely ordinary in between.

lea.name: Léa
lea.description: A Parisian woman in her thirties, middle-aged rather than young. Charming and warm, slightly flustered; speaks her most elegant French.

henri.name: Henri
henri.description: The maître d’ of a smart Paris restaurant, an older man in his fifties. Theatrical and grandiose, endlessly obsequious, grand gestures.

madame-dupont.name: Madame Dupont
madame-dupont.description: The most feared food critic in Paris, an older Parisian woman in her sixties. Dry, sharp and calm, with a sudden warm laugh.

malik.name: Malik
malik.description: Léa’s husband, a Parisian man in his thirties, middle-aged rather than young. Sweet and a little nervous, trying his politest French; warm.
